_note: Every tuning number in one place (Logan tunes; Claude's values are Proposed). Read through scripts/core/Balance.gd. Rerun the sim after changes: tools/balance_sim.sh.

combat._why: Logan 2026-09-30: fights should run about 6 turns. Applied to every Refit Bay part as it loads (ComponentLibrary), player and enemy alike, so card faces show the scaled numbers; Refit Bay keeps the originals. damage_mult scales each card's damage range (rounded, at least 1). heat_add is added to every card that costs heat (Logan: +1 across the board); vent cards (negative cost) and free cards (protocols, Quick Draw) keep theirs. hp_mult scales every part's HP (rounded): with damage_mult 0.75 and heat_add 1 it brings fights to about 6 turns (Logan's target; sim, Bastion and Jackal, 2026-09-30). heat_mult then scales the heat cost of damage-dealing cards that cost heat (rounded).
combat._why_utility: Counter/utility buff (Logan, 2026-11-19: make players want them). A card that deals no damage skips heat_add (1 Heat cheaper than before), and its Deflect and Absorb stacks are times utility_shield_mult (rounded).

heat._why: Ratio venting: at max heat (or over) this share vents; below max it scales down with the heat % (Logan, 2026-09-28).
heat._why_vent_action: The Vent action (Proposed default, 2026-09-30): a mech that spends its turn venting (the player before playing any card; an enemy with nothing it can play) vents this share of its heat at its next dispersal, as if it were at max.
heat._why_full_reset: Trial (Logan, 2026-10-02): every mech's heat resets to 0 at its dispersal, player and enemies alike, so enemies aren't stuck playing one card a turn. Smoke still holds back a point per stack, and Overpressure Valve still vents 1 less. false goes back to ratio venting (vent_at_max).
heat._why_bank: Heat banking (Logan, 2026-11-19: turns felt solved because each one starts the same). Heat the player leaves unspent at the end of a turn (bank_share of it, rounded down) is saved, up to bank_max_share of the mech's max Heat (rounded down), and raises the next turn's max Heat by that much. Saved Heat the next turn leaves unspent carries again, under the same cap. Player only. bank false turns it off.

analysis._why: Analyzed parts (Logan, 2026-11-19): as each of your turns starts, the Operator analyzes one living part of each regular and elite enemy (not bosses; never the same part two turns running if it has another). Your hits on it deal damage_mult damage. enabled false turns it off.

economy._why_shop_refit: Trial (Logan, 2026-10-02): at an autonomous bay the frame takes parts too (drag between Cargo, the workbench and the mech, as at a refit). false: the chassis only changes at a refit.
economy._scraps_why: Doubled 2026-09-30 (Logan: double the scrap so shops are worth it; runs are twice as long too).
economy._repair_pool_max_note: A repair bay heals at most this much in all (Logan, 2026-10-15).
economy._shop_note: Shop rework (Logan 2026-09-29/30: more options to buy from, no rerolls): shop_offers parts per category, each rolled for rarity; any part in Cargo or on the bench sells for its scrap value; once a visit, refine a part into a random one of its type one rarity up (refine_prices by its current rarity).
economy._scrap_note: Proposed (Claude, 2026-09-28): a part left on the refit / autonomous bay workbench is scrapped for scrap_fraction of its price, times its HP share.
economy._skip_why: Skipping a salvage pick pays scraps (Logan, 2026-09-30: 10). At least the sell value of the cheapest part offered, so taking a part only to sell it never beats skipping.

map._layout_note: Layout 2 (Logan, 2026-10-16: routes were a web or a forced lane, a stop apart): `paths` walkers climb a grid of `columns`, a stop with one way on branches at walk_branch_chance, and no route runs more than max_forced rows with one way on if it can help it. tools/map_stats.gd measures it. min/max_per_row and branch_chance are layout 1's (saves from before).
map._event_shop_note: Logan, 2026-09-30: some event stops turn out to be an abandoned autonomous bay (a shop), this often.

encounters._note: Slay-the-Spire style: a run's first `weak_fights` regular fights draw from the location's weak pool, the rest from its strong pool (a mission can override). An encounter isn't repeated within `no_repeat` fights. `local_weight` (Logan 2026-11-19: the location's own enemies a little more likely, at most about 20%, so roamers still show up): an encounter's weight is multiplied by 1 + (local_weight - 1) x its share of the location's `local` enemies (sectors.json), and each local elite weighs local_weight against a roaming one's 1.

enemy_ai._self_cost_note: How much an enemy's card choice counts what the card costs its own part (EnemyAI._self_cost): subtracted from its score. self_offline_penalty for taking the part Offline for the rest of the fight (Precision Throw), self_disable_penalty per turn of Disabled or Freeze (Wrap Up). 0 = ignored (the AI before 2026-09-30). Logan, 2026-10-13: 30 and 0 (Balance Targets; a Disable penalty made Cipher easier).
enemy_ai._why_max_cards: Fewer, bigger intents (Logan, 2026-11-19): each turn an enemy plays at most this many cards by tier (protocols and a charged shot don't count), its theme's best first, and its attacks deal intent_damage_mult damage (scaled as the enemy loads, so intents show it). 0 = no cap. Sim 2026-11-19 (20 runs a bot): 1.2 made fights harder (win rates 5-17 points down), 1.1 about even, 1.0 a little easier (Logan wants slightly easier), so 1.0 for now.
enemy_ai._why_charge_mult: Phase 6 (2026-10-13): a charged attack fires free at the start of the enemy's next turn at this multiple, unless its part is Disabled, Frozen or destroyed first.

meta._note: Chips: the meta currency (Logan, 2026-09-28). A day of 1-2 hours ≈ 2-3 runs + that day's Directives; a cosmetic should take several days.
meta._chips_why: Halved 2026-09-30 (Logan: runs are longer, and Directives should be the main way to earn Chips).
meta._memorial_note: War Room Memorial Wall (Logan: starts empty, grows a bit every run and more per elite and boss). Its first trophy (the candle) shows at 1 point, then one more per memorial_per_trophy points, up to all 14. Point values are Proposed.
meta._weekly_note: Weekly directives and streaks (Claude, 2026-09-30, Proposed): weekly_per_week goals a week; finishing all of a day's directives on consecutive days pays streak_chips_per_day × the streak's days (capped at streak_max_days).

orders._x2_note: 2026-09-30: runs doubled and scraps doubled, so Claude's scrap grants (Supply Drop, Loan Shark, Blind Drop) and fight-count durations (Cold Start, Wider Picks, Loan Shark, Hot Insertion) were doubled too. Logan's own numbers (Stripped Frame 200) are unchanged: vet.
orders._note: Deployment orders (Logan, 2026-09-29): after Launch the Operator offers three, one boost, one tradeoff and one gamble (anything random is a gamble), shown in a shuffled order without saying which is which. Numbers are Proposed (Claude) unless Logan gave them. Names and text are in data/orders.json. Orders that hand out parts open the run with a refit, with Cargo 5×5 for that refit (Logan, 2026-09-29).

modular_chassis._why: Logan's numbers; the HP cut is only on the parts you launch with (Logan, 2026-09-29), so swapping them out escapes it (a part keeps at least 1)

blind_drop._why: Logan 2026-09-29: planning matters, so it needs a huge upside; you still see two rows ahead

spare_parts._why: Logan, 2026-11-12: 3 Surplus parts (was 2), set apart from Mystery Crate

scramble._why: Logan, 2026-11-12: it swapped every installed part one rarity up; now `parts` random ones, each new part's rarity rolled like salvage (one up made it 3 free Salvaged parts)

orders._2026_09_30_note: Claude's 9 new orders (2026-09-30, Proposed): built only from effects the other orders already use. One order a run, so orders never stack (Logan, 2026-09-30).

mystery_crate._why: Logan, 2026-11-12: three sealed crates, open one blind; `parts` part(s) inside, rarity rolled `rarity_rolls` times and the best kept (as elites drop)

coin_flip._why: Logan, 2026-11-12: less volatile; tails pays tails_scraps too

conditions._note: Location modifiers and mission variants (data/conditions.json), Proposed (Claude, 2026-09-30). variant_weights: how often each variant rolls. Sim (builder, 200 runs): with Rain 10% / Jam 1 / Smoke 2 clears fell ~8 points; at Rain 5% / Jam 1 / Smoke 1 about 2-4 (Jamming is most of it).
conditions._enabled_note: Logan, 2026-10-13: location rules and sector-rolled variants stay off until locations rotate and there are several places to run, so no one is forced into a bad run. The Daily Operation still rolls a variant.

threat._note: Threat levels (data/threat.json; Logan, 2026-11-08 and 11-19): levels 1-5 per location, each unlocked by clearing the one before; each level adds its effect and keeps the ones below. Numbers are Logan's except the captured-bay odds and the elite fallback (Proposed, Claude 2026-11-19).
threat._chips_note: Each level pays +10% Chips (Logan, 2026-11-08), added: level 5 pays +50%.
threat._veteran_note: Level 1 Veterans: every enemy part's HP x this (Logan: enemy HP +10%) until each enemy has its own upgraded-part swap.
threat._elite_note: Level 2: an elite's extra opener lays its charge, else primes a protocol, else braces with this much Deflect.
threat._ambush_note: Level 3 captured bays (Logan, 2026-11-19): rolled on arrival, never the bay before the boss. The chance starts at ambush_start, rises ambush_step after each free bay and drops to ambush_after after a taken one. On a path with 3 bays: none taken 26%, one 68%, two 6%.
threat._scraps_note: Level 5 supply lines cut: 25% fewer scraps from fights (Logan, 2026-11-19).

daily._note: Daily Operation score (Claude's draft, 2026-09-30, Proposed): points per stop, elite and boss, a bonus for clearing, and 1 point per damage_per_point damage dealt.
